prompt:
Favicon-size version of a flat vector logo, as a clean SVG, square viewBox 0 0 512 512, transparent background, built to stay readable at 32 pixels. Use only flat solid fills with exactly these colours: #8A8D91, #5F6267, #1C1C1E, #F2B705, #FFF1C9. No gradients, no filters, no shadows, no opacity, no <text> elements: every symbol is drawn as <path> shapes. Very few, very bold shapes.

Subject: a rotary slide-projector tray seen from above, simplified:
1. One perfectly circular disc in #8A8D91, centred at (256, 256), diameter 480, with a plain flat rim ring in #5F6267 about 24 units wide. No notches, ticks or marks on the rim.
2. Lower half: a very bold mathematical pi symbol π in #1C1C1E, about 45% of the disc width, thick stems, rounded ends, right leg with a small outward curl.
3. Upper half, overlapping the rim at 12 o'clock: one upright slide with a thick #F2B705 frame and a PORTRAIT window #FFF1C9 that is taller than it is wide (height about 1.3 times its width). Inside the window, filling 85% of its height, the Gemini zodiac sign ♊ in #1C1C1E: two thick vertical pillars, tall and close together (pillar height at least twice the gap between them), joined by a curved bar on top and a curved bar at the bottom whose ends flare outward past the pillars, like the Roman numeral II wearing a cap and a base. It must read as ♊, two tall pillars, never as a square box or as an equals sign.

Only two things must read at 32 pixels: the π and the amber slide with ♊. No sparkle or star, no imitation of any existing company logo.
note: docs/favicon-16.png is rendered from this SVG with the Gemini sign path removed.
